svg.title: XIU — founder of XIUSoft, a curious developer. I build small things, and run them properly.
svg.desc: XIU, founder of XIUSoft and a curious developer, builds and runs LiveSSH, an SSH and SFTP client, and Bosong, a gentle mood diary. XIU the puppy stretches awake by a sunny window.

g.text: Founder of XIUSoft · a curious developer
I build small things, and run them properly.
Every project started with “could I build this myself?”
I design, build and run them on my own — now as XIUSoft,
a one-person software company in Hwaseong, Korea.
user@host and you are in. File transfers, tmux resume, AI-agent approvals.
The mood diary where even a rest counts
A few feelings and how strong they are. Entries stay on your device.
iPhone · iPad · Mac · Apple Watch · 9 languages
